'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Seth Acree LS Center Of Tyranny''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Seth Acree]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Center Of Tyranny / A Liberated World]]
* '''Username:''' sjacree
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
